_comment: Global tool policy — applies to ALL agents before per-agent rules. Re-read on every request; no orchestrator restart needed.

toolRules._comment: Argument-level rules per tool. Each tool has an argDeny array of rules.

_rule_format.when: optional — { argName: value } conditions, all must match (case-insensitive; supports dotted paths into nested args)
_rule_format.field: which argument to inspect — supports dotted paths (e.g. 'request.id') and matches across arrays
_rule_format.values: denied values — case-insensitive exact match or trailing * wildcard

argDeny.message: Creating menu items of this type is not permitted. Contact your administrator.
